title: Sierre-Zinal rules — race, date and route (art. 1–8)
claims: Article 3 defines an adult race from Sierre to Zinal 'also called the "Race of the Five Four Thousand Meter Peaks"'.
Article 4 states that the adult race and the Chandolin–Zinal junior race are in principle held each year on the eve of the second Sunday in August.
Article 7 gives the adult race as a 31 km mountain trail with 2,200 m of elevation gain and 1,100 m of vertical drop.
Article 7 states that the Runner category must use the route via Niouc, while the Tourist category may choose between Niouc and the Chapelle Saint-Antoine.

Article 5 defines the Tourist category as runners doing more than 4:30 and the Runner category as those doing less than 4:30; Tourist runners receive an official time but no ranking and no qualifying points for other competitions, and cannot include Sierre-Zinal in ITRA or UTMB indexes.
Article 8 gives the Chandolin–Zinal junior race as 19 km with 800 m of gain and 1,100 m of drop.
The rules state that figures in brackets may vary from one edition to another and become final when registration opens for that edition.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官网英文规则分页 Art. 1–8。规则开篇说明方括号内数字可逐年调整，并在当年报名开放时视为最终值；法文版为解释基准。
